description: R1c only (CP starts at R1c): lets the Virtual Walkthrough's Google Street View frame use the accelerometer and gyroscope, so the frame stops logging Google's own 'Permissions policy violation: accelerometer is not allowed in this document' console error and its 'deviceorientation events are blocked by permissions policy' warning (both are logged on legacy too: the iframe has no allow attribute). The delegation needs BOTH halves: this attribute AND the Permissions-Policy of / and /index.html naming https://www.google.com for accelerometer and gyroscope (tools/t0/config/gen.mjs, PP_APP). Evidence and the owner decision: ops/header-decisions.md section 2. Without the header (trains R0-R1b, which ship the legacy netlify.toml) the attribute is inert.

patches.note: The Street View iframe (https://www.google.com/maps/embed/v1/streetview) is the only iframe that gets an allow attribute; the NPS video frame stays without. magnetometer is NOT delegated: Chrome 153 logged nothing with accelerometer + gyroscope alone (2026-09-30 run against the real embed).
